_comment: Default tracker configuration. Shipped to <deployment>/admin/default-tracker/ by the deploy sidecar (see justfile); copied into <projectCodex>/tracker/ by /app/tracker/provision when a project opts in (or resets). The status set here is a small, sensible default — the SPA also has these as built-ins so an empty configuration still works, but a real file makes the project owner's intent explicit and the agent has something to read.
